results.detail: Re-check: the claim now states that Gen_customeraccountname is the guid lookup to the customer account and that funds are matched by the same customer-account id. Both cross-package evidence points were re-opened: 0005_Customer Account.dtsx:2644 has ExternalColumns[Gen_customeraccountname] dataType="guid" on a gen_fundmain source, and 0015_TransferIn.dtsx:75552 has join fm.Gen_customeraccountname = ca.Gen_customeraccountId. The parameter positions are unchanged and correct: ?#0 Param_0 AgentAppointmentDateToInsert, #1 Param_1 ModifiedBy, #2 Param_2 ModifiedOn, #3 Param_3 Gen_fundmainId (key). The mapping note about funds being matched by name was also corrected.

Param_1 <- Create System Variables.Output 0.ModifiedBy (guid) = new Guid(Convert.ToString(ReadOnlyVariables["User::CrmAdminId"].Value)). CrmAdminId is loaded from gen_etlvariable (scope 'global' or PackageName) by 'Get Organization Variables'. Note: an empty or invalid CrmAdminId throws FormatException in the script, so the data flow fails before any UPDATE.
Param_2 <- ModifiedOn (pipeline DT_DATE, cachedDataType="date") = DateTime.UtcNow per row. The external Param_2 is dbTimeStamp.

There is a single connection [psql] -> ALTSHULER_MSCRM, used by the source, the UPDATE, the org-variables read and the End ETL lookup on gen_etlprocess (DTSX:2319). There is no DTS:Configuration element. The CRM-DB inference is evidenced: the same connection reads the gen_etlprocess record that the package created via the SDK, and the table name is a Base table. The runtime override is correctly labelled external_unknown.
Matches the SQL. Field meanings are labelled as hypotheses. Cross-package evidence shows Gen_customeraccountname is the customer-account lookup id (see claim).
Default Success constraints: Get Organization Variables -> Create ETL -> Get All Funds -> End ETL.

Source -> Create System Variables (sync) -> OLE DB Command, with no other components. The input has errorRowDisposition=FailComponent and the error output has no path. A failure fails the data flow, and because of the Success constraint End ETL does not run. 'select distinct' gives one row per Gen_fundmainId. The detail_he hypothesis 'Gen_customeraccountname = חשבון הלקוח' is supported by cross-package evidence (a GUID lookup to gen_customeraccount).
UPDATE Gen_fundmainBase including ModifiedBy/ModifiedOn via [psql]: Unsupported.
FailComponent is confirmed, and End ETL is skipped through the Success constraint. There is no TransactionOption attribute in the file (defaults); the lack of rollback is labelled as a hypothesis.
with (nolock) appears on all three Gen_fundmain references.
FileName='reject_reasons_full_22052019' and FilePath='C:\Test\RejectReasons' are defined (DTSX:23-28). There are no references to User::FileName/FilePath or Variables.FileName/FilePath in the file.

Re-check: the logic now states that an empty or invalid User::CrmAdminId makes new Guid(...) throw FormatException with no try/catch, so the flow fails before any UPDATE and End ETL does not run. The code is at DTSX:2622 (main.cs:128). The variable default "" is confirmed at DTSX:11-12. The summary and Get All Funds text now say the match is by account id (guid lookup) with cross-package evidence.
